messages:
diego: Quick follow-up from the 1803-prod-kv-oom postmortem — we need a focused eval sprint to catch the recurring pattern where cache warmup + burst traffic causes KV OOM. Can we sketch tests + owners?

maya: Thanks — yes. I can take ownership of the regression prompt sets and targeted long-dialog KV tests. Plan: build prompt variations that exercise prefix reuse and partial cache hits.

jon: I'll own the load-test harness changes to reproduce the burst pattern. Plan: add a warmup phase then a sudden spike. ETA ~2w.

ashley: I will add chaos drills on the infra side: simulate slow disk + transient node loss during the spike window. Will coordinate timing with Jon.

eva: Suggest adding a nightly canary eval that runs the new prompt set on Canary and a quantized model variant to catch kernel regressions early.

infra-bot: New ticket created: INF-4982 - "Regression: KV cache warmup + spike test" assigned to @jon, due 2025-02-10

diego: Nice. Let's enumerate concrete action items (owner, ticket, due) so PM/eng management can track.

maya: Action: build prompt set "kv-long-dialogs". owner: maya. ticket: ML-2129. due: 2025-02-07. notes: include reuse across sessions and edge-case token alignments.

jon: Action: extend loadtest harness for burst pattern + cache warmup. owner: jon. ticket: INF-4982. due: 2025-02-10. impl details: add warmup + spike phases. Example config:
```
warmup: 60  # seconds to warm cache
spike:
  rps: 200
  duration_s: 30
```

ashley: Action: chaos drill scenario + runbook. owner: ashley. ticket: SRE-733. due: 2025-02-14. runbook snippet: step 1: trigger node-drop 1/3; step 2: inject 100ms disk latency; step 3: observe fallback to smaller-model path.

eva: Action: nightly canary eval + dashboard. owner: eva. ticket: ML-2135. due: 2025-02-12. metric: regression rate on prompt set <= 1% (alert if >1%).

diego: Also need microbench/unit tests for kernel-level changes that touch KV handling — small harness per-op. @jon can you add that? deadline 1w?

jon: Yep. I'll add a microbench harness and small unit-suite to exercise KV allocate/free and cache eviction patterns. ticket INF-4990. due: 2025-01-31.

maya: We should add gating: if nightly eval regression rate jumps post-deploy, block rollout and auto-open postmortem. @slo-bot can you create a policy?

slo-bot: Policy request recorded: P-172 - "Eval regression gating" -> will auto-create issue on threshold breach and notify oncall. Owner: oncall.

eva: :thumbsup: I'll wire up eval dashboards and add links to each ticket & PR.

diego: Can we schedule a 30m sync next Tue to confirm scopes? propose 2025-01-28 10:00 PT.

ashley: Works for me.

maya: Works for me.

jon: Works.

diego: I'll create a short summary doc and update the postmortem with the action items + links to tickets/PRs. Please ping here when PRs exist.

infra-bot: Link added to postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/1803-prod-kv-oom

diego: Thanks all. Checklist I'll add to the doc: owners, ticket links, due dates, test code PRs, nightly canary, alerts gating, chaos runbook. Ping here when items land.
